shots.visual: A woman looking into a bronze mirror, fiercely cutting her own thigh with a dagger, tears in her eyes.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 二哥，你竟然拿我當棋子！

shots.visual: A woman stuffing a blood-stained letter into the inner pouch of a horse saddle.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 皇叔，救我，我是無辜的……

shots.visual: A warlord standing on a warship deck, sneering with ambitious eyes under dark stormy sky.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 只要孫尚香一死，劉備必遭痛罵！

shots.visual: Close-up of a male villain laughing sinisterly, robes fluttering in the river breeze.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 我要讓蜀軍軍心徹底崩潰！

shots.visual: Wide shot of a military camp tent exterior at dusk, torchlight flickering.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 三日後，東吳傳來驚天訃告。

shots.visual: A strategist standing on the left holding a scroll, rushing towards a ruler sitting on the right.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公！東吳宣稱尚香夫人已死！

shots.visual: A calm emperor sitting behind a desk, his eyes sharp, cold and full of disdain.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孫權這點下作伎倆，也想騙朕？

shots.visual: A strategist holding a feather fan, fanning nervously with a troubled expression.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 可天下輿論，對我軍極為不利！

shots.visual: Close-up of a leader's face, narrow eyes showing deep calculation and foresight.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 香香性格剛烈，絕不可能自殺。

shots.visual: Wide shot of an exhausted, bloodied horse collapsing near the entrance of the military camp.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 就在此時，一匹戰馬狂奔入營。

shots.visual: Close-up of hands cutting open a leather saddle pouch to reveal a hidden blood-stained cloth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 馬腹鞍墊之中，藏著一封密信。

shots.visual: A strategist unfolding a blood-soaked silk cloth, hands trembling in utter shock.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這是……尚香夫人的血書！

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of blood writing on silk fabric with tragic cinematic lighting.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 救我，我無辜。

shots.visual: Close-up of the emperor's dilated pupils as he stares at the blood letter, violent fury exploding in his eyes.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這是她的血……孫權好狠的心！

shots.visual: A strategist holding out his hands urgently to urge composure.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公冷靜！這恐怕又是陷阱！

shots.visual: Close-up of a hand crushing the bloody letter into a tight ball, knuckles turning pale.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 陷阱又如何？朕的女人誰敢動！

shots.visual: A warlord slamming his fist onto a heavy wooden desk, standing up with overwhelming aura.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳朕旨意，全軍即刻拔營！

shots.visual: A strategist kneeling down on the floor, pleading with desperate loyalty.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，全軍直插建業太過冒險！

shots.visual: Close-up of an emperor unsheathing his sword partially, cold steel reflection cutting across his angry eyes.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 不惜代價，神擋殺神佛擋殺佛！

shots.visual: Wide epic shot of thousands of armed soldiers marching furiously out of the mist.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 三軍怒火被點燃，直奔東吳！

shots.visual: Close-up of an emperor on a battle horse, screaming ferociously towards the camera, blade raised high.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 備下！給本皇殺向建業救她！
